headline: masspeaks slips out of ARC-2 gold as cutoff rises

sections.text: masspeaks fell from 15th to 17th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board, leaving the 15 gold places with its score unchanged at 55.00.
The gold cutoff rose 2.08 points in the past day to 57.08. Kajetan Schweighofer sits 16th at 56.11, 0.97 short of the line.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
